easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast Rograkh.
You control at least one additional creature,
description:
Cast Rograkh by paying its mana cost.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Rograkh and one other creature you control, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
